= Welcome to Parch Linux Wiki =
Welcome to the official documentation and knowledge base for '''Parch Linux''' — an open-source, Arch-based operating system designed for simplicity, performance, and beauty.
{{Tip|Explore the guides below to get started with installation, desktop environments, package management, and system administration.}}

== 💻 Hardware & Packages == * [[Hardware Compatibility|Hardware Compatibility Matrix]] * [[Parch Packages|Official & Community Packages]]
== 🌐 Community & Contributing == * [https://parchlinux.com Official Website] * [https://github.com/parchlinux GitHub Repositories] * [[Contributing Guide|How to Contribute to the Wiki]]
